Title: Al-Tajweed ul Quran Academy Qatar
Description: Premier online Quran academy in Qatar offering personalized one-to-one Quran classes with certified female tutors for kids and adults.
Base URL: https://quranacademyqatar.com

# About Al-Tajweed ul Quran Academy
Learn Holy Quran online with certified female tutors. One-to-one classes for kids, sisters, and adults across Qatar (Doha, Al Rayyan, Al Wakrah, Al Khor, and Lusail). Up to 3 free trial classes available with flexible scheduling in English and Urdu.

## Services and Courses
- [Noorani Qaida](https://quranacademyqatar.com/noorani-qaida): Learn Arabic alphabets and Quran reading basics for beginners and kids.
- [Nazra with Tajweed](https://quranacademyqatar.com/quran-tafseer): Master proper pronunciation and Tajweed rules.
- [Quran Memorization (Hifz)](https://quranacademyqatar.com/quran-memorization): Structured online Hifz program with daily revision.
- [Basic Islamic Education & Six Kalima](https://quranacademyqatar.com/six-kalima): Learn the fundamental Islamic declarations and daily Duas.

## Tutors
- [Female Quran Tutors](https://quranacademyqatar.com/female-tutors): Verified and experienced female tutors available for women and children in Qatar.
